material.description: OpenStax Introduction to Political Science, §10.1 “Democracies: Parliamentary, Presidential, and Semi-Presidential Regimes” and Chapter 10 “Key Terms” (https://openstax.org/books/introduction-political-science/pages/10-1-democracies-parliamentary-presidential-and-semi-presidential-regimes; https://openstax.org/books/introduction-political-science/pages/10-key-terms): the section describes semi-presidential regimes as combining a popularly elected president with a legislature-selected prime minister, with both exercising political power; the Key Terms entry summarizes the split. The source notes substantial variation in semi-presidential arrangements and authority across countries.
